stem: Which MRR goes into the denominator of the gross MRR churn rate for September 2026 of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices?

options.text: The MRR at the start of September, before any movement
The MRR at the end of September, after all movements
The MRR at the start of September plus September's new business
The average of the MRR at the start and at the end of September
